text: The Emirates Group, Emirates airline's parent, is owned by the Investment Corporation of Dubai, 'Dubai's sovereign wealth fund'; Dubai gave Emirates about $4 billion in bailout funds during the pandemic, of which $3.6 billion has been repaid.
short: Emirates' parent is owned by Dubai's sovereign wealth fund.

source.name: Associated Press (via NY1), 'Long-haul carrier Emirates reports record annual profit of $5.2 billion'
source.quote: The overall Emirates Group, owned by Dubai’s sovereign wealth fund known as the Investment Corporation of Dubai, saw annual profits of $5.6 billion, compared to $5.1 billion the year before.
